eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 20 · Filtering and Sorting

code:
SELECT Name, ListPrice
FROM Production.Product
WHERE ListPrice > 100;

-- "ListPrice > 100" is the predicate
caption: A predicate is any expression that evaluates to TRUE, FALSE, or UNKNOWN.

code:
-- A searched CASE's WHEN is a predicate too:
CASE
  WHEN ListPrice > 1000 THEN 'Premium'
  ELSE 'Standard'
END
caption: JOIN...ON (Chapter 3) and HAVING (Chapter 4) also expect predicates.

subtitle: Combining data from multiple tables — where predicates get really important.
